Abderrahman Ait-Ali

Academic researcher in transport economics and railway systems

I work on transport economics and operations research, with a focus on public transport and railway systems. My research combines economic analysis, optimization, and decision support for questions related to capacity, maintenance, punctuality, and passenger information.

Research

Transport economics, optimization, and railway systems

My research interests combine transport economics, optimization, and decision support for railway and public transport systems.

Transport economics

Cost-benefit analysis, socio-economic appraisal, and valuation questions in public transport and railway systems.

Capacity and timetabling

Railway capacity allocation, timetable design, and operational planning under infrastructure and demand constraints.

Maintenance and life-cycle costing

Decision support for infrastructure maintenance, renewal strategies, and long-term asset management.

Passenger information

Information provision during disruptions, passenger-centric punctuality, and service quality evaluation.
